sentences.en: The kid drew back from the frog when it moved.
sentences.zh: 当青蛙动起来的时候，小孩往后退了。

sentences.en: Are frogs reptiles? I don't expect them to be mammals.
sentences.zh: 蛙是爬行动物吗？我不认为它们是哺乳动物。

sentences.en: The prince was turned by magic into a frog.
sentences.zh: 王子被魔法变成了青蛙。

senses.zh: 青蛙；[铁路] 辙叉；饰扣
